structured_output.what_is_happening: This is a copycat 'm/ep' (Memetically-Engineered Product) token. It was launched straight onto a PumpSwap pool with a non-pump mint address, a deploy platform the packet lists as unknown, and liquidity that is 100% unlocked and supplied by a creator. It is about 13 minutes old at a $31k market cap, against $36k of liquidity. It is up about 200% on roughly $216k of volume. At least 10 other tokens use the same ticker and name. The most-traded one is a pump.fun mint (6mEf...pump) at $84k market cap, launched about 14 minutes before this one. The link attached to this token points to a tweet from CookedSupermann, which suggests some viral tweet or meme is setting off a race to launch copies.

narrative.description: The name 'Memetically-Engineered Product' (m/ep) looks like it comes from a viral X post or meme. Several deployers launching copies within minutes of each other shows the phrase has real attention right now.
narrative.why_spreading: Some tweet set off a race to launch copies of the same ticker. Attention is split across more than 10 copies, and this one is not the leader.

token_connection.why_this_token: The only link is the shared name and ticker plus a generic tweet URL. There is no website, no socials, and no DexScreener profile.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 6mEf...pump is the pump.fun leader: $84k market cap, $319k 1h volume, created earlier. 7mDU... is another manual pool with $318k volume. Plus many dead or rugged copies (5ARS, CZea, FSff, 2fhh with about $0 liquidity), which shows the same kind of launch is already being rugged.

authenticity.evidence: GeckoTerminal counts 2,036 unique buyers against only 58 unique sellers in the first 15 minutes, which looks like bot or micro-buy farming. GMGN flags 40 bundler wallets holding about 31.7% of trader volume and a 32% bot/degen rate. The creator provided liquidity through a manual pool with 100% unlocked LP, and the creator's own token status reads 'creator_close'. The other copies with near-zero liquidity look like the same pool-pull pattern.
authenticity.uncertainty: Some of the buyers could be real retail joining a meme that is actually trending. Without X data I can't confirm how big the source tweet is.

structural_risks: 100% of the LP is unlocked and the pool was seeded manually by the creator, so the liquidity can be pulled at any time
Several same-name tokens already show about $0 liquidity, which fits a repeated rug template
40 bundler wallets holding about 32% of trader volume
A lopsided buyer/seller count suggests fake breadth

structured_output.counterargument: The meme is clearly hot: several copies each have more than $300k of 1h volume. This token has deep liquidity relative to its market cap, 2,000+ holders, a top 10 holding only about 16%, and mint and freeze authority renounced. If traders spill over from the leader, a $31k coin could 2x fast. The +50% move in the last 5 minutes shows momentum right now.
